opening.argument: The video presents Terra LUNA as a near-term appreciation opportunity, using an imminent “about to EXPLODE” headline and stating that the coin “could be going higher soon.” The presenter adds a possible 10% gain claim and identifies a $43 resistance level while displaying a LUNA/USD trading chart, tying the discussion to speculative participation and near-term price movement rather than neutral background information. It also directs viewers toward an investing-app reward tied to a deposit: viewers are told they can receive “up to 70 dollars with a free stock when you just deposit one dollar,” with the offer placed in the description. The record does not establish completed transactions, viewer losses, or the full terms of that offer. Ordinary requests to like, subscribe, and comment are channel engagement, not evidence of financial participation.
